title: azara integrifolia var. pycnophylla
intro: Azara integrifolia var. pycnophylla, commonly known as Pycnophylla Azara, is a variant of the Azara integrifolia plant, a species of flowering plant in the family Rutaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine due to its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Pycnophylla Azara are attributed to its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce fever, and exhibit anti-inflammatory effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include limonoids, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
